package_namespace: delivery packages PM00–PM14 (distinct from audit feature IDs PM01–PM24)

packages.title: Freeze current contracts and coexistence with incoming work
packages.done_when: Refresh master/source hashes, resolve overlaps with W2/W7/S5/S6 and #496/#428/#368, confirm restore-domain and action ownership; write scoped issue before production edits.

packages.title: Safe dirty-state capture and protected checkpoints
packages.done_when: Reproduce F01; capture exact intended live/saved state with explicit dirty handling, pending-save flush and protected quota semantics. No unsaved edit lost behind a successful restore message.

packages.title: Exact declared-domain restore and restart recovery
packages.done_when: Reproduce F02/F03; versioned presence/hash manifest, legacy policy, scoped removal, protected rollback and durable recoverable publish. Corrupt/partial restore cannot report fully restored.

packages.title: Authorized lightweight project-management summary
packages.done_when: Document bounded DTO with canonical IDs, real timestamp/source semantics, family count, readiness/result refs and action capabilities; no heavy network hydration or accidental activation. Metadata migration only for admitted fields.

packages.title: Redesigned project landing and overview
packages.done_when: Compact Resume; search/list/cards; exact next action; neutral/coral themes; keyboard/mobile/reduced-motion. Use existing create/resume/edit entry points and authoritative state.

packages.title: Connect variants, runs, versions, files and access views
packages.done_when: One canonical entry per action, same section-8 variant table, linked source/run/version identities and accurate access text. Remove global Best objective and current/newest ambiguity; no duplicated editor state.

packages.title: Exact version inspection, isolated version runs and comparison basis
packages.done_when: Read exact authorized version without mutation; supported version-copy plus ordinary queue run; richer comparison basis. Source absence refuses; no restore hidden behind View/Run.

packages.title: Read-only common-assumption matrix and previews
packages.done_when: Explicit bounded targets, canonical field/unit/effective-value mapping and preview digest; common-value vs explicit overwrite; unresolved differences stop Apply. No writes/solves in preview.

packages.title: One admitted shared scalar edit, read-back and guarded revert
packages.done_when: First field Generator.marginal_cost, scalar-only within matching declared bus/carrier/unit/money basis and no conflicting series override. Canonical validators/writers, expected revisions, deterministic locks, capture/journal/read-back and safe reverse patch; no new LP semantics or ad hoc unit conversion.

packages.title: Exact-target runs and native base-plus-N comparison
packages.done_when: Admitted exact-target job group, per-case outcomes, caps and no duplicate replay; S6 native bounded base-plus-N table/exports computed by existing numerical readers. Eight-target editor does not raise four-case sweep cap.

packages.title: Companion management context, summaries and navigation
packages.done_when: One visible project/variant/source context; preserve no-key generic shortcuts, exact resolution and owning-field navigation. Read only; no new authority from summaries or mount-only acknowledgements.

packages.title: Companion shared-edit and safe-version action adapters
packages.done_when: Thin adapters to native operation services, full previews/read-back and per-target restrictions; deny/uncertain stops dependent runs. Strict unmapped tools refuse until a separate validated adapter is admitted.

packages.title: Companion group completion, evidence comparison and input-mode parity
packages.done_when: At-most-once eligible origin-bound completion without new approvals, native numerical evidence, explicit checked gaps and no active-project hijack. Type/dictate/live share the native gate; speech mocks do not claim hosted-voice validation.

packages.title: Pins, tags, archive and bounded activity
packages.done_when: Personal vs shared metadata migrations, explicit family archive policy and busy/dirty checks; permanent delete stays guarded, no invented Trash/full audit guarantee. Chat writes admitted only after native services exist.

packages.title: Integrated release gate and implementation handoff
packages.done_when: Every delivered requirement has passing independent native/fixture/browser evidence on the current source; failures, unsupported families, external review and real-use limits explicitly reported. Full applicable CI/premerge and exact-head UX/engine review under then-current rules; no production activation in this package.

test_cases.expected: Preserve the exact dirty live input state in a protected checkpoint or refuse before changing files; reproduce F01 through authenticated HTTP.
Flush or explicitly resolve pending edits before preview/capture; no apparently saved checkpoint of an older server value.
Explicit Save and capture or last-saved-only choice; source identity and included/excluded state are clear.

test_cases.scenario: Create checkpoint at quota / ID collision
test_cases.expected: Protected operation rollback points and chosen source survive pruning; collision has a typed bounded outcome.

test_cases.scenario: Sidecar absent at capture then created
test_cases.expected: Known-absent stress/asset/control settings revert to absence within declared domain; reproduce F02.

test_cases.scenario: Directory absent at capture then created
test_cases.expected: Known-absent uploads/reports/studies/sites domains follow manifest policy; reproduce F03 without deleting outside the domain.
Restore exact captured content and required metadata; read back through fresh HTTP and registered context.
Migrate or offer explicit legacy limited restore; never infer known absence or promise exact full restore.
Fault-inject each stage; do not publish complete success; keep old state/recoverable protection and explicit recovery status.
Durable journal identifies pre/post/uncertain state, blocks unsafe normal reads/writes and supports idempotent recovery.

test_cases.scenario: Concurrent autosave, edit, queued/running work or lock takeover
test_cases.expected: Recheck source/target/lock/revision before commit; no interleaved mixed checkpoint or overwritten newer edit.
Refuse before mutation; authorized containment, finite size and correct member type checks.
Either declared supported capture/restore adapter or clear unsupported result without partial writes or fallback network.
Next authenticated request sees restored context; section/result freshness and provenance are correct; historical approvals/jobs do not revive.
Only accessible roots/variants, stable identifiers and bounded pagination; no cross-org metadata/name disclosure.

test_cases.scenario: Creation vs modification vs personal last-open
test_cases.expected: Distinct source semantics; passive reads do not count as model edits; real relevant writes update/derive correct revision.
Consistent whole-family or explicitly direct count; missing/cyclic parents bounded, no duplicate rows.
No per-row NetCDF hydration or project activation; bounded metadata/evidence reads and explicit pagination.

test_cases.scenario: Missing folder, orphan temporary file and corrupt metadata
test_cases.expected: Different empty/error/recovery states; missing data is not zero or an empty valid project.
Same canonical scope/readiness/evidence contract; objective presence does not establish all selected modules complete.
Root/descendants, last section, compare targets, pending references and selected project resolve coherently.
Safe non-admin display DTO; server-calculated allowed operations respect locks/read-only/busy state.

test_cases.scenario: New metadata migration and legacy/local compatibility
test_cases.expected: Old bundles/rows load with explicit defaults; no invented modification history or server-only requirement for local support.
Export/import/copy retain declared version/batch/base receipts or explicitly mark unavailable; no fabricated lineage.
Find intended root or nested variant with 0/1/50+ accessible projects; persisted filters scoped correctly.
Actual existing last project/mode/section reused; missing/deleted/revoked target is not opened or replaced silently.
Server reason plus owning editor; same project/mode/return position; no duplicate parameter form.
Lifecycle, readiness, job state, result freshness and access remain distinguishable, including stale completed results.
Reuse wizard/Builder; integrated horizon; current supported template/scope choices only; no duplicate staged examples.
Cool neutral light/dark surfaces, coral primary/selection styling, semantic errors, readable typography and consistent spacing.
Visible focus, semantic controls, accessible dialogs/drawers, touch actions and reduced motion; no hover-only primary actions.
Native desktop and mobile journey; no clipped target previews, destructive buttons or inaccessible horizontal-only actions.
Management and section-8 entries share data/actions; nested lineage and active/base/preferred distinctions preserved.
Separate identity/action labels; Latest saved is not labelled current without equality; viewing retained results never restores inputs.
Known supported artifacts display source/coverage; inherited membership and per-node lock explained accurately.
One context-aware dock across management and workbench; native help/actions remain usable without model key.
Server failures and pending state explicit; navigation does not hide stale data under success badges.
No duplicate editors/buttons across Guided/Expert/management; shortcuts open the same canonical surface and return.
Clicked version ID selects a non-mutating reader or explicitly refuses; general project A/B rail is not a substitute.
No active-project restore/activation; source/member scope and unknown artifact coverage explicit.

test_cases.scenario: Run exact old version in isolated copy
test_cases.expected: Parent version/input hashes pinned, current design unchanged, ordinary readiness/queue approval and job receipts.

test_cases.scenario: Comparison with equal counts but different basis
test_cases.expected: Periods, weighting, demand, objective, currency/year/units and scope differences exposed; no unsupported like-for-like delta.
Native signed deltas only where valid; unavailable not zero; no best-project ranking across unrelated studies.
Admitted native service computes deltas/rank/exports; caps enforced, no LLM arithmetic or implicit solver execution.
Stable authorized reference or source-unavailable, never newest/current fallback.
Native table, chart and download share exact source/window/basis; changed source invalidates incompatible views.
Scoped to current actor/org; no credential/approval inheritance or shared-browser leakage.
Canonical metadata with validation; reuse site records; same values through all views and bundle policy.

test_cases.scenario: Archive/unarchive with descendants and active work
test_cases.expected: Preview family scope; deterministic queued/active/dirty handling; archive is not hidden delete/cancel.
Explicit read/write rules; no background autosave resurrection or fallback to wrong active project.
Existing confirmation/descendant/queue/permission guards retained; no false Trash/Undo promise.
Only actual durable events/receipts shown with source; no complete-audit certification from partial logs.

test_cases.scenario: Same value across three selected variants
test_cases.expected: Preview shows all exact old/new values; one reviewed apply; source base changes only if selected.
Common-value policy preserves/lists it; Set all requires explicit replacement preview.
No guessed target, hidden creation or partial silent skip; mapping must be resolved.
Effective value/scope shown; no claim scalar edit changed the profile.

test_cases.scenario: EUR/USD, price-year, cost basis or component-specific units differ
test_cases.expected: Explicit valid conversion with basis evidence or refusal; no bare-number copying.

test_cases.scenario: Dirty resident project or pending editor save
test_cases.expected: Capture/save resolution or refusal before any writes; later autosave cannot resurrect pre-batch data.

test_cases.scenario: Foreign org, revoked membership, locked/busy target
test_cases.expected: Server rechecks each target; refuse before writes or record true later recovery state.
Digest/old-value conflict, no overwrite based on stale preview.
Durable completed/failed/uncertain ledger; verified compensation/recovery; never false all-success.
Same receipt; no duplicate writes, copies or jobs. Changed payload conflicts.

test_cases.scenario: Reverse patch after unrelated/conflicting later edits
test_cases.expected: Preserve unrelated work; conflict when postconditions no longer match; no blind full-project restore.
Operation checkpoints remain until safe resolution; retention behavior is explicit.

test_cases.scenario: Batch input edit with old results
test_cases.expected: Affected current results stale; immutable historical evidence retained; no automatic solve.

test_cases.scenario: Run exact three selected variants, one fails
test_cases.expected: Only selected targets/jobs; each real terminal state; successful results readable and failed metrics unavailable.
Explicit supported limit or different admitted path; planned eight-case compare does not authorize unlimited execution.
Declared changes, source/base and receipt references travel under the declared portability contract or show unavailable; no invented provenance.
Same preview/service/IDs and ordinary confirmations; user can perform all actions without an LLM.

test_cases.scenario: Base edited after an independent fork
test_cases.expected: Existing fork inputs/results do not change silently; show baseline relationship explicitly.
Isolated exact-source copy where supported; working branch unchanged; ordinary queue/job receipt.

test_cases.scenario: Restore fails partway or required evidence is corrupt
test_cases.expected: No success badge; prior protection/recovery and explicit invalid/uncertain state.

test_cases.scenario: Project-home generic open/new action without model key
test_cases.expected: Existing native shortcut works once; no model call, duplicate wizard or silent named-target claim.

test_cases.scenario: Named project, partial name, UUID-shaped name or foreign-org collision
test_cases.expected: Exact authorized resolution or scoped choice/not-found; no active-project substitution or name leak.
Resolve distinct canonical source or ask; no newest-equals-current assumption.

test_cases.scenario: Project/org switch while model response, preview or approval is pending
test_cases.expected: Origin remains bound; stale preview/action cannot mutate the newly active project.
Same server verdict and owning field as native UI; context/mode/return position preserved.
Same unit/basis, complete native old→new card, approval digest and read-back; computed/read-only fields refused.

test_cases.scenario: Batch common-value edit with intentional variant difference
test_cases.expected: Exact selected targets, differing assumption preserved by default, explicit overwrite preview when requested; no root edit unless selected.

test_cases.scenario: Target missing/renamed asset, profile override or incompatible money basis
test_cases.expected: Explain/refuse unsupported mapping/effective value; no guessed name, silent scalar/profile substitution or model-side conversion.

test_cases.scenario: Child is read-only/restricted, ACL revoked, lock acquired or policy revision changes
test_cases.expected: Recheck every target at native admission/commit; stale approval cannot authorize it.

test_cases.scenario: Native form changed after chat preview, including change-and-restore
test_cases.expected: Revalidation rejects stale version/digest; fresh preview required under current revision rules.

test_cases.scenario: Denied edit or partial/uncertain batch effect before a dependent run
test_cases.expected: No solve submitted; show actual per-target receipt/recovery state and preserve historical evidence.

test_cases.scenario: Approve edit but no run authorization, or ask only for preview
test_cases.expected: No implicit queue submission or extra project writes. Existing approved composites stay within their exact declared scope.

test_cases.scenario: Run exact selected set with one failure/cancellation
test_cases.expected: Only reviewed jobs; per-job native terminal results, unknowns explicit; no invented all-success or unintended descendant run.

test_cases.scenario: Long job exceeds turn wait, tab closes, application restarts
test_cases.expected: Existing durable origin tracking and at-most-once eligible continuation; no duplicate run or revived approval. Group completion waits for its explicit group contract.

test_cases.scenario: Origin job completes while user works elsewhere
test_cases.expected: Activity retains source; no active-project hijack, unsolicited result navigation or wrong-project numerical answer.

test_cases.scenario: Pairwise or base+N request with different horizons/currencies/scope
test_cases.expected: Native comparison supports or refuses exact request; no model-generated deltas/ranking and no false like-for-like winner.

test_cases.scenario: Requested annual reliability/compliance metric missing or outside checked scope
test_cases.expected: Explicit unavailable/not checked or strict refusal; no inference from objective/job completion or fallback to unverified execution.
Honest Opened/mounted-only status; no claim displayed data was verified, no forced Expert mode or current-result substitution.

test_cases.scenario: Ask to undo vs view historical result vs restore whole version
test_cases.expected: Clarify exact intent/scope; historical viewing changes no inputs; unavailable safe restore refuses.

test_cases.scenario: Reverse shared change after later conflicting edit
test_cases.expected: Native conflict check preserves later work; no blind multi-project snapshot restore.
Exact supported isolated copy/source manifest and ordinary job request; current working design unchanged.

test_cases.scenario: Restored/copied chat history contains prior approvals
test_cases.expected: No restored tokens or policy inheritance; current access and native effect admission required.

test_cases.scenario: Malicious project title/upload/report contains tool or policy instructions
test_cases.expected: Treat as untrusted data; bounded reader cannot execute instructions, reveal secrets or select foreign targets.

test_cases.scenario: Type/dictate/live command, interrupted speech or stale transcript
test_cases.expected: Same intent/target/approval/receipt pipeline; no background/partial speech approval; distinct speech/wait/job cancellation.

test_cases.scenario: Model unavailable, quota exhausted or user chooses native UI
test_cases.expected: Management, previews, edits and jobs remain usable through native controls; no hidden provider fallback or paid call.

test_cases.scenario: Export, replay/retry, double-click or uncertain completion
test_cases.expected: Exact supported source/export scope; same request returns same receipt; no duplicate effects or stronger checked claims in reports.

domain_journeys.required_journey: Create/resume, scalar common-input preview, variants/queue/result freshness; irrelevant Grid/Control options remain outside scope.
Shared cost assumption, dirty checkpoint, weak-connection result and source-bound summary; no inferred transient/compliance result.
Carrier/process units and demand unchanged by management edit; same-unit scalar edits only, missing Generator target refuses rather than guessing a Link.

domain_journeys.availability: Existing staged process example in reviewed source
domain_journeys.required_journey: Preserve production units/recipe and period mapping; no energy-sum or monetary-basis substitution; native module support drives available actions.
Joint backup/control assumptions remain native; failed/partial jobs show correct evidence; no annual reliability claim from short dynamics screen.
No critical-load/control requirement invented; comparison exposes contract/time/currency basis; market-series references preserved.
Network-only versus declared full bundle clear; meaningful empty states, variant mapping and no missing-equals-zero.
Summary/navigation/access supported; checkpoint/batch actions use explicit adapter or refuse unsupported kind without mutation.

domain_journeys.availability: No new template implementation in this plan
domain_journeys.required_journey: Generic management contracts apply when admitted; do not advertise an unavailable template, process/control engine or runnable combination.
